acceptance_scope: Release A local Ubuntu Docker delivery; not production deployment approval

source.note: Images were built from the repaired, uncommitted worktree. The OCI revision is the supplied base-revision test label, not a claim that these artifacts were built from that clean commit. CI must rebuild using the final committed revision.

build.command_template: BUILD_VERSION=ubuntu-20260912 BUILD_REVISION=<base_revision> IMAGE_PREFIX=self-deepsearch-acceptance docker buildx bake --builder default <target> --load --progress plain

distroless.handling: Pulled through the mirror and locally tagged with the original reference; Dockerfile base reference unchanged.

observed_network_limits: Direct gcr.io metadata lookup timed out.
Official Go module proxy timed out; explicit goproxy.cn override succeeded.
Official PyPI download exceeded a bounded build attempt; explicit Aliyun mirror override succeeded. Mirror package resolution is not asserted identical to the official index.

configuration_checks.name: Japan Compose including edge, monitoring and tools
configuration_checks.command: docker compose --env-file infra/compose/japan/.env.example -f infra/compose/japan/compose.yaml --profile edge --profile monitoring --profile tools config --quiet

configuration_checks.name: Nginx actual syntax check
configuration_checks.command: ORIGIN_CERT_FILE=<temporary-synthetic-cert> ORIGIN_KEY_FILE=<temporary-synthetic-key> docker compose -p self-deepsearch-acceptance-edge --env-file infra/compose/japan/.env.example -f infra/compose/japan/compose.yaml -f infra/compose/japan/compose.nginx-check.yaml --profile edge run --rm --no-deps edge nginx -t
configuration_checks.output: nginx: configuration file /etc/nginx/nginx.conf test is successful
configuration_checks.note: Test-only DNS override maps absent upstream names to loopback for nginx -t; never include it in a deployed edge.

runtime_method.network: Temporary Docker internal network; API and PostgreSQL were not newly exposed publicly.
runtime_method.database: Real disposable PostgreSQL, schema v21, platform_api_login least-privilege role, empty catalogue.
runtime_method.healthcheck: Original image healthcheck command retained. Runtime-only scheduling shortened to interval 2s, start period 3s, timeout 5s, retries 3 for the smoke test.
runtime_method.nonroot: Verified actual container process UIDs with docker top, in addition to image Config.User.
runtime_method.frontend: Both production Next.js containers called their own /api/v1/site/home and /api/v1/search/works?q=ABP-001 routes. PLATFORM_API_URL targeted the real Go API container, which used the disposable PostgreSQL database.
runtime_method.cache_write: Under the actual node UID, checked write access, created a synthetic file inside .next/cache, and removed it. Startup logs contained no EACCES after the fix.

fixes_verified.problem: Official Nginx entrypoint treated NGINX_ENVSUBST_FILTER as a regex, but the template supplied a variable-list expression, producing an awk regex error.
fixes_verified.fix: Use an anchored three-name regex with Compose dollar escaping.
fixes_verified.regression: Existing Nginx contract verifies permitted names and rejected unrelated variables.

fixes_verified.problem: CI nginx -t with --no-deps could not resolve upstream services that were intentionally absent.
fixes_verified.fix: Add a clearly test-only Compose DNS override and use it in the CI syntax check.
fixes_verified.regression: Actual nginx -t passed using the example environment and temporary synthetic TLS files.

fixes_verified.problem: Standalone Go Docker builds exposed module metadata missing under the workspace configuration.
fixes_verified.fix: Refresh API and Worker independent module metadata; add explicit optional Go and Python build-source arguments for restricted networks.
fixes_verified.regression: Both standalone Go module builds and all five Docker image builds passed.

fixes_verified.problem: Docker supplies HOSTNAME automatically; Next standalone bound to the container hostname instead of loopback, and the original display image became unhealthy with connection refused.
fixes_verified.fix: Set HOSTNAME=0.0.0.0 in both frontend runtime images.
fixes_verified.regression: Existing runtime-image contract checks the fixed bind address; both rebuilt frontend image healthchecks passed.

fixes_verified.problem: After the bind fix, public reads returned 200 but Next logged EACCES creating .next/cache under the nonroot user.
fixes_verified.fix: Precreate only each app's .next/cache directory owned by node; application source ownership remains unchanged.
fixes_verified.regression: Existing Dockerfile contract checks directory creation; both rebuilt images passed real UID-1000 write probes and same-origin reads without EACCES.

python.note: Existing tests were strengthened with assertions; this targeted count is separate from the parent task's full Python-suite evidence.

cleanup.superseded_three_known_untagged_image_id: Already absent at final read-only inspection; no image removal or global prune was needed.
cleanup.parent_managed_resources: Parent task removed the disposable PostgreSQL/Mailpit containers and the .cache/acceptance and .cache/core-e2e directories after preserving sanitized evidence; no acceptance containers or networks remain.

limits: No images were pushed to a registry and no public or production deployment was performed.
API image smoke ran in development configuration with identity disabled; it verified readiness and public database reads, not SMTP/authentication delivery.
Worker image smoke used Beijing mode with collection disabled; real SQL Worker contracts were accepted separately.
Media image smoke used synthetic provider settings on an internal network; no live S3/R2 or Cloudflare request was accepted.
Nginx passed real configuration parsing with synthetic TLS, not public TLS, Cloudflare Access, cross-region networking, maximum-media RSS or production-load acceptance.
